| Deck | **PROS**    | **CONS**  |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| Reed  | 🟢 Compact, lightweight, custom sized | 🟡 Pricey, still leaks |
| Lomo  | 🟢 Cheap | 🟡 Very tight fit, leaky |
| Peak UK | 🟢 Easy on/off | 🟡 Protective edge coating eventually wears |
| Whetman | 🟢 Watertight at first | 🟡 Very pricey, poor fit, prone to abrasion |
| Manic | 🟢 Adjustable | 🟡 Leaky |

# Summary
Here's a summary of the names from the pros and cons table above.

Reed = Reed Chilcheater Aquatherm Deck <br>
Lomo = Lomo Neodeck <br>
Peak = eak PS Explorer <br>
Whetman = Whetman Gripper <br>
Manic = Manic adjustable waist Deck

Overall, I would recommend one of the Peak UK decks above the others. The reasonable price, durability, fit on the deck, and relatively low leakage make them an all-round winner. A more detailed review of decks to come.

# Buyer
Everyone except for those paddlers on weird sit-on-top boats!
